fusions.name: Locked Grip
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 5 tiles onto the target and deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles. It has a 60% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrung Out
fusions.desc: Wrings the target for 8 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Sure Hold
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Hold
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
